metadata.processingCrs: Native WorldCover grid for shared-edge simplification; EPSG:4326 for clipping
metadata.sourceOverview: ESA WorldCover 2021 v200; conservative agreement with 2020 v100

method.filter: Same class in both annual products, same-class 3x3 neighbourhood support, and 4-connected patch thresholds; filters only remove unsupported cells, never grow them.
method.confidence: Conservative cross-product agreement, NOT a pixel probability or a measured local accuracy. The two versions use different algorithms; disagreement is not interpreted as land-cover change.
method.geometry: Raster polygonization, topology-preserving shared-edge simplification, exact coastline clipping and confirmed settlement subtraction; water is retained at both detail levels.
method.builtUp: Do not import WorldCover class 50. Existing project settlements remain authoritative; unmatched remote built-up classifications remain unknown.
method.water: Exclude sea-connected patches and require both annual products to agree; small accepted water patches are retained. Inland water can include ponds/reservoirs and is not asserted to be a named or currently permanent lake.

limitations: Historical 2021 land-cover reference, not a current or cadastral survey.
Tree cover includes plantations and perennial woody crops; it does not prove natural forest or land tenure.
Annual classification can confuse seasonal crops, grass, bare ground and small/mixed water bodies; excluded or disputed areas remain unknown.
Dynamic World was assessed but was not read: no configured Earth Engine authorization (public API requires authentication). No probability data or newer validation is claimed.
No Amap imagery, commercial tiles or legacy woodland polygons were used.

cartography.basis: Existing detail GeoJSON only; no new imagery or classification. Original detail coordinates remain unchanged.
cartography.method: Scale-dependent minimum patches; small enclosed hole filling; bounded same-class gap closing; gentle opening and simplification. Retained other-class patches are reserved. New display area is capped and large unknown areas remain neutral.
cartography.meaning: Overview and regional boundaries are cartographic approximations, not new field-verified land-cover data. Small omitted patches return in the detail view.
